profile.summary: East Bay Agency for Children is an Oakland nonprofit that serves children, youth and families affected by trauma in Alameda County. Its programs include family resource centers, school-based behavioral health services, after-school programs and youth empowerment programs.

sources.title: East Bay Agency For Children - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: ProPublica, ebac.org and the Alameda County Probation Resource Connection Network page all confirm East Bay Agency For Children (EIN 94-1358309, 2828 Ford St, Oakland) as a 501(c)(3) running the listed programs, and the County page lists it as a youth prevention-network member, consistent with the agenda's 'Delinquency Prevention Network' MOU. Contact fields match the contact page (general info email only), and the summary is neutral and supported.
